judgments.reason: While the span 'nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain' does appear literally in the vignette, the clinical record strongly points to Strongyloides hyperinfection syndrome (with concurrent Aspergillus) as the diagnosis rather than CKD-associated intestinal dysmotility. The GI symptoms are attributable to Strongyloides infection evidenced by positive stool ova/parasites, bronchoscopy revealing Strongyloides filariform larvae, immunosuppressive therapy, and systemic findings. Therefore, the support span does not clinically support the modifier as a reasonable component of the completed diagnosis label.
